```php
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Component;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Redis;

class TodoList extends Component
{
    // Public properties to store todo items and status
    public $items = [];
    public $status = 'all';

    // Method to fetch initial data from Redis
    public function mount()
    {
        $this->items = Redis::get('todo_items') ?? [];
    }

    // Method to save a new todo item
    public function saveItem($text)
    {
        // Add the new item to the items array and update Redis
        $this->items[] = ['text' => $text, 'status' => 'active'];
        Redis::set('todo_items', json_encode($this->items));
    }

    // Method to delete a todo item by ID
    public function deleteItem($id)
    {
        // Remove the item from the items array and update Redis
        foreach ($this->items as $index => &$item) {
            if ($item['id'] == $id) {
                unset($this->items[$index]);
                break;
            }
        }
        Redis::set('todo_items', json_encode($this->items));
    }

    // Method to toggle the status of a todo item
    public function toggleStatus($id)
    {
        foreach ($this->items as &$item) {
            if ($item['id'] == $id) {
                $item['status'] = $item['status'] === 'active' ? 'completed' : 'active';
                break;
            }
        }
        Redis::set('todo_items', json_encode($this->items));
    }

    // Render method to return the Livewire component view
    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.todo-list');
    }
}
```
